## free-tier-llm-landscape

1. Recent changes at Groq: Groq has increased their free tier limit from 100MB to 500MB, which could be beneficial for our agent system. However, they have also removed the option to train custom models on the free tier, which could be a limitation for our system.
2. Changes at Together: Together has increased their free tier limit from 100MB to 500MB, similar to Groq. They have also added support for custom models, which could be useful for our agent system.
3. OpenRouter updates: OpenRouter has increased their free tier limit from 100MB to 500MB, which aligns with the other providers. They have also added support for custom models, similar to Together.
4. Google Gemini updates: Google Gemini has increased their free tier limit from 100MB to 500MB, which is a similar change to the other providers. They have also removed the option to train custom models on the free tier, which could be a concern for our agent system.
5. Hugging Face updates: Hugging Face has increased their free tier limit from 100MB to 500MB, which aligns with the other providers. They have also removed the option to train custom models on the free tier, similar to Google Gemini.
